name: Lawless Streich
original_name: ロウレス・シュトライヒ
source:
Louise's target.

A blonde-haired soldier. He has earned the nickname "Masked Man" due to his emotionless face. He was Berger's subordinate and was very fond of him.

The client is Franz Berger, a superior officer who treated him very well, but Lawless betrayed him, and his heart has grown cold and spiteful.

[From in-game profile]
